raw: {"source":"def investigate(context, acquire):\n    return {\"query\": {\"actions\": [{\"op\": \"put\", \"id\": 5}, {\"op\": \"delete\", \"id\": 5}, {\"op\": \"put\", \"id\": 2}]}, \"note\": {\"hypothesis\": \"SQLite AUTOINCREMENT tracks sqlite_sequence maximum even after deletion; parent tracks only live rows, so it returns 3 while native should return 6.\"}}","scope":"Compare AUTOINCREMENT allocation after delete/reinsert against parent's live-row maximum model.","change":"Use put 5, delete 5, then put 2: parent high becomes 2 and predicts 3; native sqlite_sequence retains 5 and should allocate 6."}
